canonical_equations: Model=offset+sum_k(c_k*cos(2*pi*k*f*t)+s_k*sin(2*pi*k*f*t)); ordered RN32 weighted normal equations for centered y, Cholesky solve, P=(chi2_constant-chi2_fit)/chi2_constant. Exact operation graph and conditioning gate specified in contract.
output_contract: F x [u32 status,f32 power,chi2,offset,c1,s1,...,cH,sH]; status1 zero weight/variance,2 Cholesky pivot<=RN32(weight_sum*2^-16), failed numeric fields0. No analytical false-alarm, multiband or covariance claim; RN32 powers are not clipped.
result_contract: F x [u32 status,f32 power,chi2,offset,c1,s1,...,cH,sH]; status1 zero weight/variance,2 Cholesky pivot<=RN32(weight_sum*2^-16), failed numeric fields0. No analytical false-alarm, multiband or covariance claim; RN32 powers are not clipped.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
